serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
OrbusInfinity Government is a Software as a Service (SaaS) solution hosted in Azure, offering multi-tenant environments for US government agencies. OrbusInfinity integrates with your Commercial or GCC Microsoft 365 environment. Meeting FedRAMP Moderate security standards, OrbusInfinity Government ensures data security and sovereignty. 

OrbusInfinity Government provides secure SaaS capabilities that enable federal agencies to optimize technology investments, create AI-driven value, drive effective business transformation, accelerate innovation, and strengthen resilience and compliance.
With OrbusInfinity Government, federal agencies can modernize IT systems, improve citizen services, and deliver cost savings. Teams can collaborate seamlessly across enterprise architecture and project delivery domains and leverage capabilities to realize a wide range of use cases within a secure, compliant platform. Transformation insights can be shared on demand from the central repository to stakeholders via personalized dashboards, to guide successful transformation outcomes. 

OrbusInfinity Government enables federal agencies to: 
Optimize Delivery of Public Services: Design streamlined citizen-centric digital services, improving accessibility, visibility, and public trust. 

Accelerate Technology Modernization Initiatives: Generate the blueprint for cloud migration, legacy system replacement, and adoption of new technologies, reducing risk and ensuring alignment with agency goals. 

Support Budget Accountability and Investment Planning: Provide clear visibility into IT assets and initiatives to track spending, prioritize investments, and deliver measurable cost savings, driving transparent accountability reporting including OBR. 

Optimize Mission Areas: Align technology and resources with core mission areas, providing a holistic view of how capabilities, applications, people, and processes work together to deliver services, enabling agencies to continuously improve and optimize critical functions. 

Optimize Government Resources and Reduce Costs: Identify redundant systems, streamline IT portfolios, and make smarter investments. 

Strengthen Cybersecurity and Compliance: Align systems and processes with federal security standards (such as FISMA, FedRAMP, NIST), reducing vulnerabilities and audit risk. 

Enable Real-Time Insights and Data-Driven Decisions: Utilize a single source of truth to act on real-time insights, manage risk, and respond more effectively to emerging priorities. 

Enhance Collaboration and Break Down Silos: Foster better communication and coordination across departments, programs, and between agencies, supporting cross-government initiatives. 

Increase Accountability and Transparency: Map processes, data, and systems, to gain clear oversight and demonstrate compliance with laws, regulations, and policy mandates.
